name: ghostprint
description: Development tooling for the GhostPrint Firefox extension

scripts.check: node --check settings.js && node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node --check inject.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8')); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); if (manifest.version !== pkg.version) { console.error('version mismatch: manifest '+manifest.version+' vs package '+pkg.version); process.exit(1); } console.log('version parity ok ('+manifest.version+')');"
